newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo to depreciate as EMU approaches -Cisf.
newsitem.headline: Escudo to depreciate as EMU approaches -Cisf.

text.p: The escudo should slowly depreciate towards its central EMS rate against the mark of 102.50, given the increasing likelihood of Portugal joining monetary union from the start, Banco Cisf said in its weekly market report.
But this should not prove an obstacle to any convergence of interest rates, it added.
The currency was trading at 100.56/59 to the mark on Tuesday.

The central rate refers to its mid-point inside the European Monetary System (EMS) currency grid and this could come to be seen as the likely rate of conversion into the euro -- the single currency -- which is due to be launched in January 1999.
But over the short-term, the currency could appreciate due to the coming privatisation of EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, it added.
The last time the currency touched 102.50 was in August 1996.
